requests.source_owner: Motorola / Lenovo for exact donor identity
minimum_first_response: Match device suffix, sales region, main-board and USB-board revision to a controlled regional service BOM; do not alias XT2551-1/-2/-3/-5/-6.
Confirm permission and permitted deliverables for the RAZR SLIDE engineering use; public repair access does not grant modified-product manufacturing rights.
Provide native mechanical keep-outs/datums and exact board, battery, main/display-FPC terminal drawings, and full key-component schematic/netlist or explicitly state unavailable.
requests.hard_block_if_unavailable: Cannot freeze the actual two-cabin donor interface, battery envelopes, OEM board interconnect and controlled native assembly.

minimum_first_response: Offer an orderable about-7-inch full touch/DDIC/COF/seal/FPC module and exact revision, with controlled native outline and local thickness limits.
Resolve the recovered drawing-versus-body pin/rail/touch discrepancies for any offered SKU before pin assignment enters PCB.
Confirm dynamic rolling permission for the project material transport, bend direction, minimum permitted radius, tension, pressure and twist; fixed-curvature or fold-only permission is insufficient.

Provide matching module samples and supplier qualification conditions/results, including post-motion optical/seal/touch criteria and dwell/flat-storage behavior; distinguish sample availability from production qualification.
requests.hard_block_if_unavailable: Cannot freeze panel geometry, PCB interface, support geometry or dynamic OLED qualification.

minimum_first_response: For signal, USB, each pack discharge and each pack charge path, approve artwork/netlist, stackup, copper type/grain/layer thickness, coverlay/adhesive/shield and physical terminal/clamp/stiffener drawings.
Approve transported material-station curvature and twist through full S79.75/Q8.2 motion, or propose a corrected manufacturable route using the same product envelope.
Return allowable current/temperature and actual dynamic continuity/insulation/crack and USB impedance/eye qualification conditions for the same revision, with samples traceable to those files.
requests.hard_block_if_unavailable: Cannot derive actual copper strain/fatigue, independent protected cable geometry or whole-motion USB/power qualification.

public_downloads_do_not_close: Native OEM CAD/ECAD and actual donor identity
Chosen fully specified dynamic OLED module
Project-specific dynamic FPC stackup and artwork
